description: Turn one of the user's CVs into a matching LinkedIn profile — headline, About section, experience entries and skills — in a language LinkedIn supports. PRO and AI consent. Use when the user wants to create or update their LinkedIn profile from their CV.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

language.description: Language of the LinkedIn profile, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE". Defaults to the result language.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: generate_takemeup_linkedin
title: LinkedIn optimizer (PRO)
